title: Neuroinflammatory Response and Headache Control in Patients After Subarachnoid Hemorrhage
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the relationship between the Neuroinflammatory response and headache pain after subarachnoid hemorrhage.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Non-traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage
* Age \> 18 years
* Treated with external ventricular drainage

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy or lactation
* Age \< 18 years
* Traumatic SAH
study_population: Eligible patients are patients with a non-traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage who are treated with an external ventricular drain for symptomatic hydrocephalus.
